FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How do I start?

Choose a plan, message Ahmed on WhatsApp first, then continue to the assessment form.

Can the plan fit my schedule?

Yes. Your available days, session time and equipment are collected in the assessment form.

Is follow-up included?

Weekly progress follow-up is included in the listed plans.

Is the nutrition plan flexible?

Nutrition guidance is built around your goal, preferences and routine.
